authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual coherence with no structural collapse or anatomical errors. However, the surface texture of the croissants has a slightly uniform, waxy quality that resembles modeling clay or plastic more than baked pastry. Real croissants typically show sharper, more irregular flaking at the edges and tips. While the lighting and shadows are realistic, this textural smoothness prevents a perfect authenticity score.
key_defects: Surface texture lacks fine flaky micro-details, appearing slightly waxy or plastic-like.
Tips and edges show minor fusion/smoothing rather than sharp, distinct points.
